title: Learning Management System (LMS)
subtitle: Full-Stack EdTech Platform with RBAC & Dynamic Quiz Engine
shortDescription: A full-scale educational platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB featuring role-based dashboards for students, instructors, and administrators.
description: Designed and engineered an institutional Learning Management System that addresses the friction in modern online education. Includes course authoring, progress tracking, dynamic quizzes with automatic grading, and comprehensive student analytics.
problem: Educational institutions struggle with fragmented tools for course delivery, grading, and student progress tracking.
solution: A centralized platform supporting custom video hosting, interactive quiz evaluations, and distinct dashboard experiences tailored to students and instructors.
features: Course authoring with rich media embeds and modular lesson builder
Dynamic timed quiz system with instantaneous grading and review
Real-time student progress tracking and visual course analytics
Responsive UI built with Tailwind CSS and React Hook Form

title: Interactive Full-Stack Resume Builder
subtitle: Multi-Template Document Generator with A4 PDF Precision
shortDescription: An editorial-grade resume authoring platform featuring live split-screen previewing, multiple design templates, and high-DPI client-side PDF export.
description: Engineered a production-ready resume builder providing job seekers with instantaneous typographic feedback across multiple industry-tested templates. Supports ATS-friendly layouts, developer-focused formats, and executive sidebar designs.
problem: Traditional resume builders lock users into restrictive paywalls or produce malformed, non-ATS compliant PDF files.
solution: A free, fast, local-first web app with real-time vector rendering, auto-saving draft storage, and 1-click A4 PDF export using HTML2Canvas and jsPDF.
features: Live two-column editor with synchronized real-time document preview
6 curated templates: Modern, Minimal, Professional, Developer, Elegant, Compact
1-Click high-fidelity vector PDF generation matching exact screen layout
Local persistence with auto-save draft recovery
Granular customization for technical skills, achievements, and project links

title: Portfolio & Editorial Digital Showcase
subtitle: Architectural Personal Website with Physics-Based UI & Custom Admin Console
shortDescription: A high-performance personal web platform combining refined serif typography, interactive desk lamp physics, secret authenticated login, and a full CMS backend.
description: Built to demonstrate mastery across full-stack engineering and visual design. Features smooth GPU-accelerated GSAP scroll reveals, an interactive 3D-styled desk lamp with Web Audio click sounds, and a comprehensive admin console.
problem: Generic template portfolios fail to reflect deep full-stack engineering competency and lack persistent dynamic content control.
solution: A custom-coded platform powered by Express.js REST APIs, persistent database storage, and fluid micro-animations that make browsing memorable.
features: Editorial design system with dual light/dark architectural themes
Interactive 3D-styled desk lamp with realistic pull-chain physics and Web Audio
Protected secret admin console with JWT authentication and full CRUD controls
Dynamic section management and integrated Form Builder engine
Consistently 95+ Lighthouse performance scores and sub-second load times
